name: Kpi Definition
description: Produces a complete KPI definition document with metric name, business question, formula, data source, owner, update frequency, baseline, and target for each KPI. Outputs a populated metric catalog table, not advice about which KPIs to consider. Use when the user asks to define KPIs, set up performance metrics, create a measurement framework, or build a metric catalog for a business area. Do NOT use for metric hierarchy and goal trees (use metric-framework), dashboard layout design (use bi-dashboard-spec), or personal goal setting (use smart-goal-builder in productivity).
